用于 Krea2_Turbo_Exciter_HR 的 Krea2 扩散模型的工作流程。

->https://civitai.red/models/2855912/krea2turboexciterhr

-> https://civitai.red/models/2857493/cushys-wildcard-collection?modelVersionId=3259867

->YANC节点包增强版：https://github.com/cushycrux/ComfyUI_yanc

  • 如果缺少某些内容（红色 X 或红色框），请单击管理器图标，然后单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”按钮。

  • 此工作流程允许在正面提示窗口中出现负面提示，如下所示：(rain:-1)，即使在 cfg 1 处也是如此。

已上传版本1.4- 5 级。这需要多加注意才能理解。附加功能：手动和随机深度图传输（Controlnet）。它仍然具有早期版本的所有功能。

先决条件（仅限 1.4）：

https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet

krea2-controlnet 必须手动安装，不在管理器目录中。这非常简单。打开网站（上面的链接），单击绿色的“代码”按钮并选择最后一个选项（下载 ZIP）。现在打开该 ZIP 文件并将其中的文件夹放入自定义节点目录 (...\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\)。使用管理器重新启动 ComfyUI。完毕。

从这里下载深度控制-lora.safetensors：
https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/tree/main 并将其放入您的 lora 文件夹中。重新选择LoRaKrea2 控制 LoRa 加载器节点。完毕。

已上传版本1.3- 4级。这需要稍微注意才能理解。附加功能: 手动、随机风格转移。它仍然具有早期版本的所有功能。

已上传版本1.2- 3 级。仍然可读。这个版本有通配符，可以让你添加随机的 LoRA，触发词会自动添加到您的提示中并馈送到提示增强器中。有一个很好的开关来打开或关闭功能。 （您需要添加自己的LoRa，并更改触发词）

已上传版本1.1 具有通配符集成。如果你想稍微提高一下你的游戏水平。

1.01- 就这么简单，如果您不想要任何随机的东西并且保持整洁。

如果您需要新的集成内容，请发表评论，否则我会随着时间的推移逐渐使其变得更加复杂。

o.en:
Workflow for Krea2 diffusion models as used for Krea2_Turbo_Exciter_HR.

->https://civitai.red/models/2855912/krea2turboexciterhr

-> https://civitai.red/models/2857493/cushys-wildcard-collection?modelVersionId=3259867

->Enhanced version of YANC nodes pack:https://github.com/cushycrux/ComfyUI_yanc

  • If something is missing (red X or red frame) click on the manager icon and then click on the *install missing custom nodes* button.

  • This workflow allows negative prompt in the positive prompt windows like this: (rain:-1) even at cfg 1.

Uploaded Ver 1.4- Level 5. This needs a little bit more attention to understand.Additional feature: manual and random depth map transfer (Controlnet). It still has all the features from earlier version.

Prerequisites (1.4 only):

https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet

krea2-controlnet MUST BE INSTALLED MANUALLY, IS NOT IN THE MANAGER CATALOG. This is super easy. Open the website (link above), click on the green "Code" button and take the last option (download ZIP). Now open that ZIP file and put the folder inside it into your custom-node directory (...\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\). Restart ComfyUI with the manager. Done.

Download depth-control-lora.safetensors from here:
https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/tree/main and put it into your lora folder. Reselect the LoRa in theKrea2 Control LoRa Loadernode. Done.

Uploaded Ver 1.3- Level 4. This needs a little attention to understand.Additional feature: manual and random style transfer. It still has all the features from earlier version.

Uploaded Ver 1.2- Level 3. Still readable.This version has wildcards and lets you add random LoRA's,with the trigger word automatically added to your prompt and fed to the prompt enhancer. With a nice toggle to turn functions on or off. (you need to add your own LoRa's, and change the trigger words)

Uploaded Ver 1.1 that has wildcard integration. If you want to step up your game a little.

1.01- As simple as it gets, if you don't want anything random and keep is uncluttered.

Leave a comment if you need something new integrated, otherwise I will gradually make it more complex over time.
